_readme: Machine-readable declaration of the portable MUIO cases this repository ships,
read by MUIOGO's /clews install layer (EAPD-DRB/MUIOGO PR #519+): MUIOGO fetches
the archive, verifies it against the vintage's SHA256SUMS, and imports it.
Policy: this file declares ONE vintage — the latest, best calibration for the
country. Every case variant (environmental accounting layers etc.) should be
built against that calibration and listed here; older build directories stay in
the repository as provenance but are not offered for install. When a new
calibration is released, this file moves to it in the same commit.
Keep this file in step with the build directory: every archive listed must
exist under the vintage's dir and appear in that dir's SHA256SUMS.
name: Philippines
